title: setup never sees a Phoenix project as person-facing
what: detect() finds an Elixir Phoenix project (lib/<app>_web/) as person-facing, so setup turns on the look review (product plugin) for it.
why: Found 26 Oct by the design of setup-turns-off-for-a-project-the-plugins-it-doe: os.path.exists with a "*" never matches a real folder.
failing_case: A folder with lib/shop_web/ gives detect()["ui"] False.
pass_cases: lib/shop_web/ gives ui True; a folder without any lib/*_web gives False.
where: lib/relay_setup.py detect(): os.path.exists("<root>/lib/*_web") takes the glob as a literal path
